change: Split oversized verification batches before dispatch, preserve all shared design rules and sibling definitions, deduplicate source metadata, and stop unsendable single targets before provider calls.
constraints: Original claim text, typed executionSpec values, quotations, table data, locations and own-reference permissions are preserved.
Source aliases distinguish work, version and title; no cross-version merge.
All requests use the existing tracked call/token admission and conservative reservation.
No retry of submitted calls; completed subrequests use the durable result on replay.
A split does not declare context claims verified or publish them.

offlineReplay.limitation: Local failed fixture verdicts prove request construction only. Four requests replace one for this input, increasing conservative reservation and possibly actual cost; admission can stop the run within its existing maximum.

review.scope: Three source/test files; no papers or runtime data; tools disabled; request retries zero.
review.result: No split termination or own-reference leakage found. Adopted typed handling for fixed-content capacity failure; unrelated legacy naming and transport heuristics were not changed.
review.boundary: Review snapshot preceded source-registry compaction. Final metadata and typed-field preservation are separately tested and reviewed by the primary agent.

rejectedApproach: Role-specific reduction of shared design requirements failed the existing joint-contract regression and was reverted. All original role requirements remain.

realCase.interpretation: Provider rejected the initial brief request. No extraction, repair or verification occurred. Reserved ledger tokens are not measured billed usage. HTTP 402 alone does not identify the precise account cause.

failurePresentation.change: Confirmed model HTTP 402 failures now advise checking account quota and billing without exposing raw provider diagnostics. Unknown calls still take precedence and remain paused; unrelated or stale errors are not mislabeled.
failurePresentation.loadObservation: Initial health observations timed out during startup. The same running container subsequently returned healthy; no extra restart was performed.

acceptance: Full offline regression passed. New runtime content quality remains untested because the initial provider request returned HTTP 402. DR0-DR5 remains incomplete.
